The Turner & Townsend subagent I spawned has now returned, and its findings independently corroborate the report I already delivered. No correction is needed.

Three incremental details from it that strengthen the T&T section:

1. **Vincent Clancy's exact title is "Chairman and Chief Executive Officer,"** not just CEO. Confirmed on T&T's live leadership page and in their FY2025 results release of June 4, 2026, which quotes "Chairman and CEO Vincent Clancy." No succession signal in either.

2. **UK Companies House independently confirms the ownership bands.** CBRE Titan Acquisition Co. Limited holds "more than 50% but less than 75%"; Turner & Townsend Partners LLP holds "more than 25% but not more than 50%." No 2026 persons-with-significant-control notification. Most recent filings: group accounts July 14, 2026 (FY2025), confirmation statement June 5, 2026 marked unchanged. This is a second primary source agreeing with the 10-Q's 70/30.

3. **T&T FY2025 results, published June 4, 2026 (pre-window):** global revenue £5.76bn gross, described as record growth, "majority-owned by CBRE Group" with partners holding "a significant non-controlling interest." Building reported July 16, 2026 that T&T paid £174m in dividends. Both pre-window, useful as baseline context only.

Also worth noting for the AI question: the 8-K Item 5.02 I flagged as "March 23, 2026" was the **Anuj Kadyan CTO hire**. That is CBRE's most recent disclosed technology executive appointment, and it sits roughly seven months before your window. So the accurate framing remains: no AI or technology executive hire between August 1 and October 23, 2026.

My delivered report stands unchanged.
